summary: test_cancelling_slug_editor_does_not_rename_task types 'discard-me' into the input, presses escape (action_cancel dismisses None, so rename() returns early), then asserts fake.set_slugs == [] (no set_slug RPC reached the fake task service) and the detail pane still renders the original 'fix-widget' slug; since the fake's set_slug is the only path that mutates task slug data, this also proves the underlying task record is untouched. Genuinely rejects the nearest violation (escape leaking the typed-but-uncommitted value through as if it were submitted).
